text:
Eli V.: hi all, first day! :wave: where's the canonical place for onboarding checklists and engineering templates in Notion? i found the company home but not the team templates. also who to ask for edit access?

Tara (DevEx): welcome @Eli V.! :tada: Engineering templates live under Workspace > Spaces > Engineering > Onboarding & Templates. Read-only link: https://redwood.notion.site/Engineering-Onboarding-templates. For edits, please submit the Notion edit request form and specify which page(s). Link: https://forms.redwood.com/notion-edit-request

Eli V.: thanks. do we have a naming convention so contractors/new hires don't create duplicates?

Marco (Infra): yes. we use: [Team] - [DocType] - [ShortDesc] - [OwnerInitials] - [Temp?]. duplicate the template instead of editing the master, update the metadata block (Version / Owner / Last edited) at the top, then ping the owner to add it to the index.

Tara (DevEx): small note: if the template has no owner, mark the owner field "TBD" and put the link in #devex. we run notion-sync-bot weekly which pulls the metadata and updates the Onboarding index.

Eli V.: perfect, i'll duplicate the checklist and submit the form. one last q: who approves contractor edits for infra docs?

Marco (Infra): infra approvals come from the Infra Platform guild. if it's urgent, ping me or @Olivia. otherwise the edit form routes to the owner listed.

notion-sync-bot: Indexer - Onboarding index updated (new page placeholder added).

Eli V.: awesome, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
